cay_instructor.text: The Cayman Islands have one of the great dive scenes on Earth: walls that drop away into blue, wrecks like the old frigate sunk on purpose off Cayman Brac, and visibility you could read a newspaper in.
Rule one: don't touch the coral. Rule two: see rule one.

cay_novice.text: I've been breathing through a tube for forty minutes and I'm not dead. This is the best day of my life.
Is it true that sharks can smell fear? Because I'd like to stop that now.
